status: Editorial worldbuilding reference only; does not create executable gameplay
inspiration_limit: Original cozy fantasy village social depth; do not copy specific Disney Dreamlight Valley IP, plots or systems
connection_rules: Every district remains distinct and has voluntary civic work, social leisure and weather constraints.
The seven districts do not replace the six characters' separate homeworlds.
Activities named unwritten_optional have not happened in the 300 chapters.
No activity promises romantic exclusivity or erases other adult partners.
Cultural performance remains with its makers and cannot be appropriated.

daily: Open: check posted routes, stock and weather; resident-hosted activities are optional
Midday: craft, repair or learning can happen only if hosts have agreed
Evening: music, tea and social conversation coexist with cleanup and quiet hours
weekly: Work rosters, public corrections and voluntary gatherings are reviewed
People with other obligations can decline; a missed gathering is not a friendship failure

spring: Public inspection of shoreline storm hardware
summer: Market shade and safe water availability
Short music sets and ingredient-labeled snacks
autumn: Longlight kite repairs and lantern-hook checks
Storm drain inspection before the rains
Paid shift planning ahead of reduced daylight
winter: Indoor instrument maintenance and archive visits
Accessible bridge alternatives and supply ledgers
